people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
translations.bsb: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
translations.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
translations.asv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
